title: 书店里的猫
summary: A frequent visitor and the bookshop owner follow a missing cat and discover an old note that leads to a treasured secret.
topic: A bookshop cat leads to a discovery

blocks.hanzi: 小雨经常去街角的那家旧书店看书。店里有一只猫叫小黑，它总是安静地躺在窗边。
blocks.translation: Xiaoyu often goes to the old bookstore on the street corner to read books. There is a cat named Xiaohei in the store, it always lies quietly by the window.
blocks.pinyin: xiǎoyǔ jīngcháng qù jiējiǎo de nà jiā jiùshūdiàn kàn shū 。 diàn lǐ yǒu yī zhǐ māo jiào xiǎohēi ， tā zǒngshì ānjìng de tǎng zài chuāngbiān 。

blocks.hanzi: 这一天，小雨又来了。她发现小黑不见了。
blocks.translation: That day, Xiaoyu came again. She found that Xiaohei was missing.
blocks.pinyin: zhè yī tiān, xiǎo yǔ yòu lái le. tā fā xiàn xiǎo hēi bù jiàn le.

blocks.hanzi: 大明，小黑今天怎么没在窗边？
blocks.translation: Da Ming, why isn't Xiao Hei by the window today?
blocks.pinyin: Dà Míng, Xiǎo Hēi jīntiān zěnme méi zài chuāng biān?

blocks.hanzi: 我也奇怪。早上它还在这里，后来就不见了。
blocks.translation: I was also surprised. In the morning it was still here, but later it disappeared.
blocks.pinyin: Wǒ yě qíguài. Zǎoshang tā hái zài zhèlǐ, hòulái jiù bújiànle.

blocks.hanzi: 他们一起在书店里找小黑。书架很高，书很多。
blocks.translation: They looked for Xiao Hei together in the bookstore. The bookshelf is very tall and there are many books.
blocks.pinyin: Tāmen yìqǐ zài shūdiàn lǐ zhǎo Xiǎo Hēi. Shūjià hěn gāo, shū hěn duō.

blocks.hanzi: 突然，小雨听到一个微弱的声音，好像是从角落传来的。
blocks.translation: Suddenly, Xiao Yu heard a faint sound, as if it came from a corner.
blocks.pinyin: tūrán, xiǎo yǔ tīng dào yī gè wēi ruò de shēng yīn, hǎo xiàng shì cóng jiǎo luò chuán lái de.

blocks.hanzi: 那边！我好像听到猫叫了。
blocks.translation: Over there! I seem to hear a cat meowing.
blocks.pinyin: nà biān! wǒ hǎo xiàng tīng dào māo jiào le.

blocks.hanzi: 他们走到角落，发现那里的书掉了几本在地上。
blocks.translation: They walked to the corner and found that several books had fallen on the ground.
blocks.pinyin: tāmen zǒudào jiǎoluò, fāxiàn nàlǐ de shū diào le jǐ běn zài dìshang.

blocks.hanzi: 小黑是不是藏在书架后面？
blocks.translation: Is Xiaohei hiding behind the bookshelf?
blocks.pinyin: Xiǎo Hēi shì bù shì cáng zài shūjià hòumiàn?

blocks.hanzi: 他们移开书架，发现了一个小缝隙。里面有一张旧纸条。
blocks.translation: They moved the bookshelf aside and discovered a small gap. Inside was an old note.
blocks.pinyin: tā men yí kāi shū jià ， fā xiàn le yī gè xiǎo fèng xì 。 lǐ miàn yǒu yī zhāng jiù zhǐ tiáo 。

tokens.gloss: a piece of (one + measure for flat)

blocks.hanzi: 我的朋友，你喜欢这本书吗？它是我最珍贵的回忆。
blocks.translation: My friend, do you like this book? It is my most precious memory.
blocks.pinyin: wǒ de péng yǒu, nǐ xǐ huān zhè běn shū ma? tā shì wǒ zuì zhēn guì de huí yì.

blocks.hanzi: 纸条的背面写着：“在《百年孤独》的书里，藏着一个秘密。”
blocks.translation: On the back of the note was written: 'In the book "One Hundred Years of Solitude", a secret is hidden.'
blocks.pinyin: zhǐ tiáo de bèi miàn xiě zhe : “ zài 《 bǎi nián gū dú 》 de shū lǐ , cáng zhe yī gè mì mì 。 ”

blocks.hanzi: 这本书我好像见过！
blocks.translation: I seem to have seen this book before!
blocks.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ hǎoxiàng jiànguò！

blocks.hanzi: 他们找到那本书，发现里面夹着一张老照片和一张书签。
blocks.translation: They found that book and discovered inside it was an old photo and a bookmark.
blocks.pinyin: tā men zhǎo dào nà běn shū ， fā xiàn lǐ miàn jiā zhe yī zhāng lǎo zhào piàn hé yī zhāng shū qiān 。

blocks.hanzi: 这好像是书店以前的老板。
blocks.translation: This seems to be the bookstore's previous boss.
blocks.pinyin: zhè hǎo xiàng shì shū diàn yǐ qián de lǎo bǎn

blocks.hanzi: 原来，这张照片是书店的创始人，他把自己最爱的书和照片留在了店里。
blocks.translation: It turns out that this photo is the founder of the bookstore, who left his favorite books and photos in the store.
blocks.pinyin: yuánlái, zhè zhāng zhàopiàn shì shūdiàn de chuàngshǐrén, tā bǎ zìjǐ zuì ài de shū hé zhàopiàn liú zài le diàn lǐ.

blocks.hanzi: 小黑真是个聪明的猫，它带我们找到了这个秘密。
blocks.translation: Little Black is really a clever cat; it led us to find this secret.
blocks.pinyin: xiǎo hēi zhēn shì gè cōngmíng de māo, tā dài wǒmen zhǎo dào le zhè gè mìmì.

blocks.hanzi: 这时，小黑从另一个书架上跳下来，慢慢走到他们身边，“喵”了一声。
blocks.translation: At this moment, Xiao Hei jumped down from another bookshelf, slowly walked over to them, and let out a 'meow'.
blocks.pinyin: zhè shí, xiǎo hēi cóng lìng yī gè shū jià shàng tiào xià lái, màn màn zǒu dào tā men shēn biān, “miāo” le yī shēng.

blocks.hanzi: 谢谢你，小黑！我们找到了一个温暖的故事。
blocks.translation: Thank you, Little Black! We found a warm story.
blocks.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ, Xiǎo Hēi! Wǒmen zhǎodào le yī gè wēnnuǎn de gùshì.

blocks.hanzi: 从此以后，小黑还是喜欢在窗边睡觉，但每当有客人来，它都会轻轻叫一声，好像在说：“这里有很多秘密等着你。”
blocks.translation: From then on, Little Black still liked to sleep by the window, but whenever a guest came, it would gently meow once, as if to say: 'There are many secrets waiting for you.'
blocks.pinyin: cóngcǐ yǐhòu xiǎohēi háishì xǐhuān zài chuāngbiān shuìjiào dàn měidāng yǒu kèrén lái tā dōu huì qīngqīng jiào yīshēng hǎoxiàng zài shuō zhèlǐ yǒu hěnduō mìmì děngzhe nǐ
